summary: The change sequences provider refreshes, aborts superseded requests, times out stalled requests, clears invalid or empty states, and adds regression coverage without an actionable defect.

evidence: static/admin-supervisor.js:208-250 adds refresh generations, aborts prior requests, fences async results, and clears the strip on timeout or failure.
static/admin-supervisor.js:161-163 handles empty provider lists, while lines 149-156 provide an accessible unavailable list item and first-load wording.
tests/admin-supervisor-follow.test.ts:329-438 covers response failures, out-of-order refreshes, and timeouts.
